stage: proposal; must be committed before implementation or measurement
hypothesis: A corridor crop can turn a compact object into a flat scan line or an elevated/floating signature. Recovering full-cloud connected context may restore evidence while rejecting fragments connected to extended infrastructure.
diagnostic_examples: Set O frame616:42 exact object returns span1.77m vertically; corridor cluster is5 points with zero observed height,4 strict voxels; retained only for STOP continuation.
Set O frame470: edge cube has49 source points,24 voxels,4 strict voxels; compact0.26x0.32x0.26m, floating-demoted.
Novel placements include thin and floating/elevated misses in multiple backgrounds; model-relative membership is diagnostic, not surveyed truth.
eligibility: Only current-frame corridor clusters: kind empty, original thin true OR original reason floating/elevated.
Original strict support n_gauge >= cluster.gauge_min_points; original reason must be empty/floating/elevated. Never column, overhead, edge, wall_face, retro, beyond_axis, beyond_height_ref.
Original candidate distance <= both current axis-valid and height-valid ranges; accumulation count must equal1.
Original non-thin zone-gauge candidates and already reported output objects are never downgraded or otherwise edited.
construction: Seed with original cluster.points_idx in the mount-corrected full input cloud before corridor crop.
Compact extent L is existing cluster.oversize_split_max_length (3m); require L>0. This single bound applies to each XYZ span; no search or new object-specific dimensions.
Use production range transform f(p)=p/(1+norm(p)/range_scale), production voxelize and cluster_labels with unchanged cluster config.

Compute R=max(seed point norm)+sqrt(3)*L, s=range_scale, e=eps+2*sqrt(3)*voxel. Let U=R/(1+R/s). If U+e>=s, reject unresolved. Otherwise B=e/(1-(U+e)/s)^2 bounds physical reach of a normalized neighbour, including voxel-cell padding.
Query full-cloud points inside the seed XYZ bounding box expanded by L+B on every face. Cluster that query with production voxelize/cluster_labels.
Require every seed point to have the same non-noise component label. Use all raw points of that component as context. Reject if any XYZ component span>L or >cluster.max_extent.
Boundary guard: reject if any component point is within B of a query-box face. Do not accept a component whose unknown continuation could lie outside the bounded query.

Recompute context lateral/height against the unchanged track model. Reject existing hard infrastructure, retro, column, overhead, edge or wall_face signatures on full context. No trust/geometry exclusion may be overridden.
promotion: Require full-context observed Z span>=existing cluster.min_height.
Only then expose original thin candidate to normal tracking with thin=false, or change original floating/elevated candidate zone to gauge and clear its demotion reason.
Keep original points_idx, centroid, bbox, distance, strict voxel counts and confidence score: full context supplies evidence validity only. Keep all confirmation, tracking and keep rules unchanged.
No query may create an obstacle without original strict support. No source labels, object identity, source frame numbers, ground truth or synthetic-match data enter detector behavior.

acceptance.benefit: At least2 intended-inside object families improve sustained STOP distance>=10m OR longest missed approach>=20%, across at least2 background groups with independently checked geometry; otherwise partial/ineligible.
acceptance.nonregression: All183 baseline gate values present with no worse rows; outside/background false STOPs no higher; all72 novel cases retained with no lost whole case or per-shape matched-frame count.
acceptance.uncertainty_cost: At most5percentage points extra CAUTION per empty recording/ride; median estimated range>=0.95 baseline.
acceptance.runtime: p95 decode+detect<=100ms through ROS; report added context timing and query sizes. Runtime failure rejects the candidate.
acceptance.raw_cache: Score raw bags alongside caches; report every changed object and false-alarm metric.

required_tests: realistic compact target clipped by envelope top recovers context
floating compact in-envelope target vs connected extended infrastructure
true compact target touching long structure stays baseline behavior if context unresolved
columns, retro and unsupported geometry never promoted
selection: One fixed variant. No threshold retuning after results; retain and reject failed trial. D1 remains separate from P4 association candidate A1.
